name: hybrid-parallel-2

# ============================================================
# HYBRID PARALLELISM 2 — bots với cookies c.txt, d.txt, e.txt
# ============================================================
# Chuyển xu đến TRANSFER_DEST_ID: 71394255
# 14 bots: ck47-ck60
# - ck47-50: cookie c.txt
# - ck51-55: cookie d.txt
# - ck56-60: cookie e.txt
# ============================================================

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  run-bot:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 360
    concurrency:
      group: hybrid2-${{ matrix.group }}
      cancel-in-progress: false
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      max-parallel: 5
      matrix:
        include:
          - group: g1
            bots: "ck47.py ck48.py"
            cookie: "c.txt"
          - group: g2
            bots: "ck49.py ck50.py"
            cookie: "c.txt"
          - group: g3
            bots: "ck51.py ck52.py ck53.py"
            cookie: "d.txt"
          - group: g4
            bots: "ck54.py ck55.py"
            cookie: "d.txt"
          - group: g5
            bots: "ck56.py ck57.py ck58.py ck59.py ck60.py"
            cookie: "e.txt"

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install playwright websocket-client psutil requests
          playwright install chromium --with-deps

      - name: Print group info
        run: |
          echo "=== Group: ${{ matrix.group }} ==="
          echo "Cookie: ${{ matrix.cookie }}"
          echo "Bots: ${{ matrix.bots }}"
          echo "Runner: $(nproc) vCPU, $(free -g | awk '/^Mem/' | awk '{print $2}') GB RAM"

      - name: Run bots in parallel (Hybrid Parallelism)
        env:
          MAX_CLAIMS: '40'
          HEADLESS: 'true'
          COOLDOWN: '3'
          REST_BETWEEN_RUNS: '5'
          MAX_RUNTIME: '21000'
          TRANSFER_DEST_ID: '71394255'
          TRANSFER_ENABLED: 'true'
          PRE_CLAIM_TRANSFER_THRESHOLD: '50000'
          MAX_CLAIMS_PER_DAY: '120'
          MAX_TRANSFERS_PER_DAY: '20'
          SESSION_START_JITTER: '180'
          IDLE_EVERY_CLAIMS: '40'
          GROUP_BOTS: ${{ matrix.bots }}
          SINGLE_COOKIE_FILE: ${{ matrix.cookie }}
        run: |
          set +e
          mkdir -p /tmp/bot_logs

          run_bot() {
            local bot="$1"
            local name="${bot%.py}"
            local LOG="/tmp/bot_logs/${name}.log"

            (
              END_TIME=$(( $(date +%s) + ${MAX_RUNTIME} ))
              ATTEMPT=0
              while [ $(date +%s) -lt $END_TIME ]; do
                ATTEMPT=$((ATTEMPT+1))
                REMAIN=$(( END_TIME - $(date +%s) ))
                echo "=== [$name] [$(date '+%H:%M:%S')] Attempt #$ATTEMPT — ${REMAIN}s left ==="
                START=$(date +%s)
                python3 "$bot"
                EXIT=$?
                DUR=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
                echo "=== [$name] [$(date '+%H:%M:%S')] exit=$EXIT after ${DUR}s ==="
                REMAIN=$(( END_TIME - $(date +%s) ))
                if [ $REMAIN -le 30 ]; then
                  echo "[$name] Time up — stopping retry loop."
                  break
                fi
                echo "[$name] Sleeping 60s before retry..."
                sleep 60
              done
            ) > "$LOG" 2>&1
          }

          PIDS=()
          for bot in $GROUP_BOTS; do
            name="${bot%.py}"
            echo "[$(date '+%H:%M:%S')] Starting $bot -> /tmp/bot_logs/${name}.log"
            run_bot "$bot" &
            PIDS+=($!)
            sleep 12
          done

          echo "Waiting for all bots to finish..."
          for PID in "${PIDS[@]}"; do
            wait $PID
          done

          echo "=== FINAL LOGS ==="
          for f in /tmp/bot_logs/*.log; do
            echo "--- $f ---"
            tail -20 "$f"
          done

      - name: Upload logs
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: bot-logs-${{ matrix.group }}
          path: /tmp/bot_logs/
          retention-days: 3
